stemMd: The author would most likely agree that a shorter disclosure can be better when it

options.label: A
options.textMd: cannot be located by anyone outside the inventor's firm.

options.label: B
options.textMd: omits a crucial instruction to reduce page count.

options.label: C
options.textMd: contains fewer words even if nobody can reproduce the method.

options.label: D
options.textMd: communicates the necessary steps clearly to the relevant skilled audience.

options.label: E

explanationMd: The passage distinguishes usable completeness from page volume. A concise document can rely on legitimate shared background while still enabling a skilled reader to recover the invention; shorter is not automatically better.

distractorRationale.a: Findability is part of the concern.
distractorRationale.e: The author allows notation familiar to the relevant community.
distractorRationale.c: Brevity alone is not the standard.
